data_product_overview:
## About this dashboard
The Prescription Search Report within ePACT2 provides authorised users with detailed access to prescription data at item level. This report is designed to enable users to search for specific medicines, prescribers, or organisations and view associated prescribing patterns and costs. Users can filter data by multiple parameters, including BNF codes, time periods, and geographical areas, making it a powerful tool for bespoke analysis.

The report captures data from prescriptions dispensed in the community and processed by NHS Prescription Services. It includes details such as the item prescribed, prescriber information, and dispensing data. This functionality supports SICBLs, practices, and commissioners in monitoring prescribing behaviour, identifying trends, and validating submissions.

The primary aim of the Prescription Search Report is to provide transparency and granularity in prescribing data, enabling local health economies to undertake detailed reviews and audits. While highly comprehensive, this report should not be used in isolation but alongside other dashboards to provide context and inform medicines optimisation initiatives. By offering item-level insights, it helps organisations identify opportunities for improvement, ensure compliance with prescribing standards, and support cost-effective prescribing practices.
